The bibliography identifies Gallia, Patria, Francia as David Gene Frye’s 1991 Duke University PhD dissertation.

basis: The author of Indians into Mexicans completed a different dissertation at Princeton in 1989; Gallia, Patria, Francia is a Duke dissertation by David Gene Frye in 1991. These are distinct doctoral careers.
